notes: Customer profile: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) building in-app support assistant + contextual doc search for customers.
Primary stakeholder: Lina (Product Manager) - wants sub-300ms p95 for short query completions in support UI.
Infra contact: Marcus (Head of Platform) - needs VPC peering, KMS for key management, and egress estimates for cost model.

Trial behavior (hosted_api): avg QPS 12, peak QPS 58 during business hours spike, average concurrency 6, observed 85% of requests <= 150 tokens (short replies), 15% are long-context summarization / code-like snippets averaging 1.8k tokens.
Token mix matters: ~70% generation tokens vs 30% input tokens; cost sensitivity high for generation-heavy workload.
Latency targets: p50 ~80-120ms, p95 target <300ms. Current hosted trial p95 observed ~420ms at peak — batching/caching suggested.
Use-case nuances: reranking for search results is CPU/QPS sensitive; want deterministic fallbacks to smaller models when load spikes.
Quote from Lina on 2026-02-24 call: "We like the hosted experience but need a predictable unit cost and guaranteed throughput for Q3 rollout."
Security ask: full SOC2 Type II report, SSO/SAML integration guide, audit-log retention options (90/365 days), and data residency confirmation for NA only.
Reqs for Dedicated: expected 24/7 baseline throughput of 30 qps with ability to burst to 80 qps for up to 3 hours/day; concurrency target 10 sustained during peak; autoscale/burst policy required.
Internal funding note: procurement prefers three committed scenarios (12m/24m) for price breaks; target ARR bucket $60k-$200k depending on commit and retention.
SE notes (Priya): Recommend dedicated pool with 4 x A10s or 2 x A100 L4-equivalent + autoscaling to handle burst; KV-cache and prefix caching will reduce tokens by estimated 18-22% for FAQ flows.
Observed quality: hosted trial used redwood-verified-1 and a smaller open model for fallbacks; product team wants model catalog options and automatic routing by latency/cost.
Finance/conversation: CFO wants a clear per-1M-token blended price and example monthly bill for 1M vs 10M generation tokens; provided preliminary workbook.
Action items: build Dedicated sizing doc with estimated GPU count, expected p95 under target load, and committed pricing tiers by 2026-03-05. Include VPC peering diagram and SSO SAML steps.
use_case_summary: Holloway Helix is evaluating Redwood Hosted API for an in-app support assistant + document search tied to product analytics. After a 30-day hosted trial, they want a Dedicated sizing proposal to achieve predictable latency and unit costs for a planned Q3 rollout.
sizing_estimate: Based on trial telemetry (avg 12 QPS, peak 58 QPS, concurrency 6, token mix heavy on short responses): initial Dedicated recommendation = 3-4 GPU pods (equiv. 4 x A10 or 2 x A100-class) with autoscale headroom to add +50% capacity for bursts. Expected sustained baseline 30 QPS, burst 80 QPS. KV/prefix caching expected to reduce token volume 18-22%; estimated committed monthly throughput for ARR scenarios: conservative 1M gen tokens/month (~$5k/mo usage), mid 5M (~$18k/mo), aggressive 15M (~$45k/mo) — finalize after model selection & batching config.
